description: Subject: Before the open house, set your comfort zone | Preheader: A practical way to think about the full monthly cost.
html_content:
A practical way to think about the full monthly cost.

MORTGAGE OPTIONS, MADE CLEAR

THE HOMEBUYER EDIT

Find your home. Know your numbers.

Hi {{first_name}}, it’s easy to focus on a listing price. A confident plan also considers what homeownership may cost month to month and at closing.

Have you set a monthly range that feels comfortable?

Look beyond principal and interest

Property taxes, homeowners insurance, mortgage insurance, and association dues may affect your monthly budget.

Plan for cash to close

Down payment, closing costs, and reserves can all matter. Your actual costs depend on the property and loan.

Leave room for real life

Choose a payment range that leaves space for the other parts of your budget.

If you share your rough price range and timeline, we can help you identify useful questions to bring to your home search.

Warmly,
The GoRealo Team

html_content:
Compare current options using your own loan details.

MORTGAGE OPTIONS, MADE CLEAR

A QUICK RATE CHECK

A rate is only useful when it fits your picture.

Hi {{first_name}}, mortgage rates can change, and the advertised number may not match your situation. Compare the rate, APR, points, fees, and estimated payment together.

Are you comparing a purchase or a refinance?

Make it a fair comparison

Loan type, term, credit profile, down payment, property, and points can all affect pricing.

Look at APR and costs too

A lower note rate may come with different upfront costs. Review the full offer before deciding.

See live options

Use the current rate page to compare programs and terms. Rates can change without notice and are not a commitment to lend.

Reply with purchase or refinance and your state. We’ll help you find a relevant starting point.

name: GoRealo — Refinance nurture
description: Subject: Does your current mortgage still fit? | Preheader: Compare the whole cost before considering a refinance.
html_content:
Compare the whole cost before considering a refinance.

MORTGAGE OPTIONS, MADE CLEAR

A FRESH LOOK

Your plans change. Your mortgage can be reviewed, too.

Hi {{first_name}}, a refinance may be worth exploring when your goals or finances change. The right comparison includes closing costs, the new payment, and how long you plan to keep the loan.

What would you most like a refinance to help you do?

Compare the break-even point

Consider how upfront costs relate to any monthly difference and how long you expect to keep the new loan.

Check APR, term, and total interest

A payment change can come from a different loan term as well as a different rate.

Use your current details

Rates and eligibility depend on your loan, property, credit, and other factors.

Reply with your goal—lower payment, different term, or another reason—and we can help outline what to compare.

Warmly,
The GoRealo Team

Review refinance rates

html_content:
A few details can narrow the options worth exploring.

MORTGAGE OPTIONS, MADE CLEAR

OPTIONS, MADE CLEAR

Let’s find a loan path that fits your plans.

Hi {{first_name}}, conventional, FHA, VA, USDA, and jumbo programs each have different requirements and costs. The best place to start is with your goals and eligibility.

Are you buying, refinancing, or still exploring?

Start with the basics

Purchase price, down payment, location, property type, and credit profile help shape which options may fit.

Compare costs side by side

Review rates, APR, mortgage insurance, points, and estimated cash to close.

Ask about eligibility

Program guidelines differ. A loan professional can help you understand what may apply to your circumstances.

Tell us your goal and whether you have a target timeline. We can help you focus on the right questions.

description: Subject: Ready to turn your home search into a plan? | Preheader: A preapproval can help clarify a realistic shopping range.
html_content:
A preapproval can help clarify a realistic shopping range.

MORTGAGE OPTIONS, MADE CLEAR

WHEN YOU’RE READY

A clear next step can make the search easier.

Hi {{first_name}}, if you’re preparing to shop for a home, a mortgage preapproval can help you understand your options and what information a lender needs.

Do you have a target month for your move?

Know what to gather

Income, assets, debts, and property details may be part of the review. Requirements depend on your situation.

Keep your plans flexible

A preapproval is not a final loan approval. Your eligibility and terms depend on underwriting and the property.

Ask before you apply

If you want to talk through the process first, reply to this email and tell us what is unclear.

Reply with your timing and we can help you understand the next step. No pressure if you’re still planning.

Warmly,
The GoRealo Team

html_content:
A calm, practical starting point for first-time buyers.

MORTGAGE OPTIONS, MADE CLEAR

FIRST HOME, CLEAR PLAN

You don’t need every answer to begin.

Hi {{first_name}}, your first home purchase can feel like a lot to coordinate. A few simple questions can make the next conversation more useful.

What part of buying feels least clear right now?

What payment fits your budget?

Think about a monthly range that works with your other expenses, not only the home price.

What funds may you need?

Down payment and closing costs vary by loan, property, and transaction.

What timeline feels right?

A realistic timeline helps you plan document gathering, preapproval, and your home search.

Reply with one question—budget, down payment, loan options, or timing—and we’ll help you find a place to start.

A SMARTER START

Your income story deserves a clear review.

Hi {{first_name}}, if you’re self-employed, preparing income and business records early can help a lender understand your application. Documentation varies by loan and borrower.

Are you hoping to buy in the next few months?

Gather the basics

Tax returns, business records, bank statements, and other documents may be requested.

Talk through income early

How qualifying income is calculated depends on documentation, program rules, and your circumstances.

Plan before touring

An early conversation can help you understand a realistic range before you make an offer.

name: GoRealo — Rate education
description: Subject: A quick guide to comparing mortgage rates | Preheader: Rate, APR, points, and payment belong in the same conversation.
html_content:
Rate, APR, points, and payment belong in the same conversation.

MORTGAGE OPTIONS, MADE CLEAR

THE RATE CHECK

The lowest number isn’t the whole offer.

Hi {{first_name}}, when you compare mortgage offers, make sure you’re looking at the same loan amount, program, term, points, and assumptions.

Have you received more than one quote?

Rate is the interest charged

The note rate helps determine principal and interest, but it doesn’t show all borrowing costs.

APR brings costs into view

APR reflects certain loan costs and can help compare offers, though the assumptions still need to match.

Confirm the assumptions

Credit score, loan-to-value, property, occupancy, and points can change the quote. Published rates can change without notice.

Reply with the parts you’re comparing and we can help you frame useful questions for your lender.

Warmly,
The GoRealo Team

html_content:
Tell us what changed and we’ll help you pick up where you are.

MORTGAGE OPTIONS, MADE CLEAR

PICK UP WHEN IT WORKS

Your plans can move at your pace.

Hi {{first_name}}, you may still be comparing options—or your plans may have changed. Either way, a short reply can help us point you to a useful next step.

Is your goal still on your radar?

If you’re ready

We can help you review current options and understand the application process.

If you’re waiting

We can share educational resources so you can revisit the decision when it suits you.

If your plans changed

Just tell us. We’ll update the conversation around your current goal.

Reply with “buy,” “refinance,” “later,” or a question. We’ll tailor our response to where you are.
